answer: A farm that wants 287 keys hence forfeits 287 sequential derivations, which cannot be parallelised without buying proportionally more hardware. Because the derivation is a one-way function of the comet seed, the grove timing is verifiable from the pulse record, and the operator cannot fake the cost. Key derivation for an identity is deliberately slow at 395 seconds of sequential work, so minting one key is trivial once and expensive in bulk. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
